Legs.Subject: Conjugate(U,V) equals (U,−V) for the (0,−1) relation, where P is the carrier's additive identity — checked against the raw pair directly rather than through a sibling type's own conjugate, so a defect in Conjugate's P-degenerate short-circuit (e.g. wrongly forming U+P·V) is caught. ENVELOPE: Add/Subtract/Negate and this P-additive-identity branch of Conjugate never read P or Q, so testing one relation exercises them for the whole (0,−1)/(0,0)/(0,+1) family; Conjugate's P-nonzero branch is separately pinned by algebra.quadratic-surd-twin-lane's (k,1) relation
